## canvas
- viewBox: 0 0 1280 720
- format: PPT 16:9

## mode
- mode: pyramid

## visual_style
- visual_style: brutalist

## colors
- background: #F4F1E8
- secondary_background: #F8F6F1
- primary: #7A9004
- accent: #D7FF00
- secondary_accent: #2FF3E0
- body_text: #090909
- secondary_text: #62615E
- divider: #C0BEB7

## typography
- title_family: "Arial Black", Arial, "PingFang SC", sans-serif
- body_family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif
- font_family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif
- display: 55
- title: 42
- metric: 36
- subtitle: 24
- body: 21
- annotation: 12

## icons
- library: tabler-outline
- inventory: book-2, sparkles, users, chart-bar, alert-triangle, target-arrow
- stroke_width: 1.5

## pptx_structure
- mode: flat
